title: GTA 6 broke every record before it even launched 🤯 #GTA6
description: 40 billion views before release, 6.5 million people watching at the same time at launch.

scenes.label: people watching live at the same time
scenes.voice: Six and a half million people were watching GTA 6 live at the same time. An all-time record.

scenes.label: YouTube views before release
scenes.voice: Before it even came out, GTA 6 videos had already pulled forty billion views on YouTube.
And when that record fell, the game wasn't even out in Europe yet.
Did you watch the launch live? Tell me in the comments.
